name: council
description: Deliberation tools, one per question: decision-council when a costly call is yours to make (independent specialists advise), best-of-n when you want a problem solved and built after comparing distinct approaches (drafted in parallel from different starting points when the problem is open-ended, and measured when checks can tell the finalists apart), risk-evaluation for what could go wrong with one plan, and ask-specialist for one bounded, hard question.
